state.catalog: PartnerIndependenceDecision holds one personal evaluation bound to an exact engagement revision, service epoch and ratified-rule digest. Its selected materialization receiver command is MaterializePartnerIndependenceDecision, but its effectKind is claim_professional_assertion_identity.
state.implementation: The receiver verifies an authorized engagement source fact and constructs a child operation with the engagement as first owner. The decision owner is tenant/evaluationId, materializes one fact, and checks child root, cause, target and first owner tenant/area. It does not read the frozen intent or verify the actual source event. PartnerIndependenceEvaluationRecorded contains OperationId equal to evaluationId in the stream resource, Revision, operation provenance and immutable content references. The selected catalog event is the same recorded fact.
state.test: Owner tests check invalid identity and routing refusal without a fact, valid replay retaining content and refusal of another materialization. An added test supplies an engagement-area first owner whose resource is not an engagement UUID.
